item.title: Rupee rises 21 paise to 90.73 against the US dollar in early trade
item.description: MUMBAI: The rupee surged by 21 paise to 90.73 against the US dollar in early trade on Monday, aided by a sharp fall in global crude oil prices and a weaker greenback amid renewed uncertainties over US President Donald Trump hiking tariffs to 15 per cent. item.title: “Our partnership continues to reach new heights”: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on PM Modi’s upcoming visit
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu termed Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s upcoming visit to Israel as “historic”, saying the partnership between the two countries continues to scale new heights across innovation, security and regional cooperation. item.title: Stock markets trade higher in early session tracking rally in Asian peers
item.description: MUMBAI: Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty opened on a firm note on Monday, led by strong buying in banks and services stocks, tracking a rally in Asian markets. item.title: Indian Embassy issues advisory for its nationals in Mexico after drug lord El Mencho killed
item.description: The Embassy of India in Mexico on Monday issued an advisory to Indian nationals residing in the country, urging them to exercise caution and remain indoors amid escalating violence after Mexican soldiers killed a top drug cartel leader. item.title: Heavy snowfall strands 350 tourist vehicles near Sikkim’s Tsangu; rescue operations underway
item.description: SIKKIM: Approximately 350 tourist vehicles are stranded near Tsangu between Sipsu and 16th mile along the Jawaharlal Nehru (JN) Road under Sherethang CP/PS jurisdiction following heavy snowfall reported around 11:30 am on Sunday. Due to persistent snowfall in the Sherathang belt, the army has suspended vehicular movement in the affected stretch as a precautionary measure. [...]

item.title: Two Balloons With Pakistan Markings Recovered in Akhnoor Sector, Probe Launched
item.description: JAMMU: Two balloons bearing markings linked to Pakistan were recovered from Village Gunara near Nili Nallah in the Akhnoor sector of Jammu district on Monday, prompting a police inquiry. Official sources said the balloons were found in an open area under the jurisdiction of Khour Police Station. The material reportedly carried a Pakistani mobile phone [...]

item.title: Toy Drone Found on School Lawns in Jammu’s Domana
item.description: JAMMU: A drone was found on the lawns of a private school in the Domana area of Jammu on Monday, officials said. According to officials, the device was first spotted by a security guard, who immediately informed the local police station. A police team rushed to the spot and seized the drone for examination. item.title: Bombay High Court quashes order staying proceedings against Anil Ambani to classify his bank accounts as fraud
item.description: MUMBAI: In a setback to industrialist Anil Ambani, the Bombay High Court on Monday quashed a single bench interim order that stayed proceedings initiated against him and Reliance Communications Ltd to classify their bank accounts as fraud. item.description: JAMMU: The White Knight Corps on Monday said that seven dreaded terrorists were eliminated in a prolonged 326-day high-altitude joint operation in the Chatroo area of Kishtwar district.
